findings.obs_text: In Deu 33:9 the Levite who says he does not regard father and mother is the one who kept the Lord's covenant: withholding regard from kin stands with keeping. In Rom 2:26 the uncircumcised man who keeps the precepts is counted as circumcised: the keeping is the ground of the counting. In Ezr 8:29 keep and weigh are guarding the gifts and weighing them by measure.
findings.grounds: will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision

findings.obs_text: In Heb 11:26 Moses counted the reproach of Christ above the treasures of Egypt because he looked to the reward: the counting is set by what he looked toward.
findings.grounds: for he was looking to the reward

findings.obs_text: In Heb 11:26 the counting weighs two riches: reproach for Christ is counted greater wealth than Egypt's treasures.
findings.grounds: greater wealth than the treasures of Egypt

findings.obs_text: In Pro 12:10 the righteous is the one whose regard reaches the life of his beast, set against the cruel mercy of the wicked: regard here is caring knowledge of another's life.
findings.grounds: Whoever is righteous has regard for the life of his beast

findings.obs_text: In Psa 119:117 the psalmist asks to be held up and kept safe so that he may have regard for the statutes continually: being kept safe is what lets the regard last.
findings.grounds: have regard for your statutes continually

findings.obs_text: In Isa 33:8 the absence of regard for man stands in the list with despised cities and broken covenants. In 1Ti 6:1 servants count their masters worthy of honor so that God's name is not reviled: the counting guards against reviling. In Act 28:22 regard is the link word for the sect spoken against everywhere.
findings.grounds: so that the name of God and the teaching may not be reviled

findings.obs_text: In Judg 15:3 in regard to is the link naming the Philistines toward whom Samson will be innocent when he does them harm; serve is not in view, do is his doing of harm.
findings.grounds: I shall be innocent in regard to the Philistines

findings.obs_text: In Isa 33:8 broken covenants stand in the same list as no regard for man: the withdrawal of regard is one of the marks of the breaking.
findings.grounds: Covenants are broken; cities are despised

findings.obs_text: In Deu 9:27 Moses asks the Lord not to regard the people's stubbornness, wickedness and sin: not regarding is withholding the reckoning of the sin. In Eze 18:28 the wicked man considered and turned from his transgressions: considering is the start of turning from sin.
findings.grounds: Because he considered and turned away from all the transgressions

findings.obs_text: In Heb 11:19 the counting is of God as able to raise from the dead: Abraham counts on God's power.
findings.grounds: He considered that God was able

findings.obs_text: In Gen 24:22, Jos 7:21 and Eze 5:1 weighing is the weight of what is taken: the ring and bracelets the man took, the gold bar Achan took, the balances the son of man takes. In Mat 1:20 Joseph is considering these things when the angel tells him not to fear to take Mary: the considering stands before the taking.
findings.grounds: But as he considered these things

findings.obs_text: In Rom 4:19 Abraham's faith did not weaken when he considered his own body: considering the body as good as dead did not weaken him.
findings.grounds: He did not weaken in faith

findings.obs_text: In Ecc 2:11 the Preacher considered all his work and toil and found it vanity and a striving after wind: the considering is a review of his toil that reaches its verdict.
findings.grounds: Then I considered all that my hands had done

findings.obs_text: In 2Ch 6:19 Solomon asks the Lord to have regard to the prayer and plea of his servant: regard is God's turning toward the supplication, and the verse gives it with listening to the cry.
findings.grounds: have regard to the prayer of your servant
